name: App Icon: Duotone Shadow Katana Draw
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Dynamic Combat Silhouette.
description: Solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai in ready-strike posture drawing a katana blade, framed inside a single solid flat bright red circular sun.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector logo icon. (Solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai ninja warrior in low combat stance drawing a katana sword:1.3). (Directly centered inside a single solid flat bright red circular sun disc:1.4). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only (#FF2035). Flat 2D vector stencil logo design, razor-sharp clean geometric edges, no white color, no human face, no skin, no 3D rendering, no soft lighting, no shading, no gradients, no textures, no noise, no rays, no text, no watermark.
